Name: Total Level Affected by Spacecore Skill
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img]

This mod normalizes the Farmer's level (which the title on the skill screen is based off of) to 30. While doing so, it adds in spacecore skills you have installed into the calculation. Finally, it makes mastery cave require farmer level 25 out of 30. So some examples....

[list=1]
[*]If you have no spacecore skills installed, you can get the Farmer king title and reach Farmer level 30.
[*]If you have 5 spacecore skills installed, you will need to reach an average level of 8 (with one skill to level 9) with all skills to reach the 25/25 goal for perfection.
[*]People using spacecore skills can't just rush vanilla skills to get mastery cave unlocked, leading to more "vanilla" progression with modded skills.
[/list]
Why did I make this mod? Point 3 above is the main reason why. It leads to a more vanilla progression with the extra skills installed. It does make things harder, but stardew is a game about taking your time. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img]
I have not tested this mod with other mods just yet. I just made sure it functions with the required mods + space core custom skill mods, and it does. 



[i][size=5][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/size][/size][/i]
[size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the SpaceCoreLevels folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/PYiimss.png[/img]
